2610.10906.title: Reading the Room: Foundations, Design, and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
2610.10906.paper_summary: Human communities are governed by normative systems: shared standards that produce \textit{norms} dictating acceptable behavior, enforced through community sanctioning. Aligning increasingly autonomous AI systems with these norms is a central alignment challenge, complicated by the fact that norms are vast in number, change quickly, and are often arbitrary (e.g., dress or language conventions). Thus, alignment requires \textit{normative competence}: the ability to discern from interaction alone what norms a community enforces without relying on static pretrained knowledge. We introduce a multi-agent community debate setting, where access to debate is governed by synthetic norms, to study normative competence in isolation from pretraining exposure. We show that baseline LLM agents fail to learn norms even when doing so would improve their accuracy. We then experiment with various \textit{normative modules} -- architectural components for norm inference -- finding that norm-following is highly sensitive to both the style of norm and the model powering the normative module, suggesting a lack of generalizability. Furthermore, when idiosyncratic, non-normative behaviors accompany the true norm, LLM agents exhibit an unselective attribution failure: they indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside enforced rules, a pattern that persists even when imitating unnecessary behaviors is explicitly penalized. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to operationalize and evaluate normative competence in LLMs, demonstrating that current AI systems excel at behavioral mimicry but lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.
2610.10906.paper_summary_zh: 人類社群受到規範系統的治理：共享標準產生\textit{規範}，指導可接受的行為，並通過社群制裁來執行。將日益自主的AI系統與這些規範對齊是一個核心的對齊挑戰，因為規範的數量龐大、變化迅速，且往往是任意的（例如，穿著或語言慣例）。因此，對齊需要\textit{規範能力}：僅通過互動來辨別社群所執行的規範，而不依賴靜態的預訓練知識。我們引入了一個多代理社群辯論環境，其中辯論的訪問受到合成規範的治理，以便在不依賴預訓練暴露的情況下研究規範能力。我們顯示基線LLM代理即使在學習規範會提高其準確性時也無法做到。我們隨後實驗了各種\textit{規範模塊}——用於規範推斷的架構組件，發現遵循規範對規範的風格和驅動規範模塊的模型高度敏感，這表明缺乏可泛化性。此外，當特異性、非規範的行為伴隨著真實規範時，LLM代理表現出不選擇性的歸因失敗：他們不加區分地複製特異性噪聲和強制規則，即使在明確懲罰模仿不必要行為的情況下，這種模式仍然持續。據我們所知，我們的工作是首個在LLM中操作化和評估規範能力的研究，顯示當前的AI系統在行為模仿方面表現出色，但缺乏辨別社會強制秩序的能力。
